title: One quick thing
subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself so we can set things up properly.
waitingTitle: Waiting for a parent or guardian
waitingBody: We emailed {email} a link to approve your account. Ask them to check their inbox (and the spam folder). You can start as soon as they approve.
waitingBodyNoEmail: We emailed your parent or guardian a link to approve your account. You can start as soon as they approve.
waitingNotYet: Not approved yet. Ask your parent or guardian to open the email from Tessera.
consentTitle: A child in your care wants to use Tessera
consentIntro: {name} told us they are under 13 and gave your email address as their parent or guardian's.
consentWhat: A study app for making flashcards and reviewing them with practice modes and spaced repetition.
consentDataTitle: What we store for a child's account
consentData1: A display name and the sign-in email address
consentData2: Birth month and year (to apply these protections)
consentData3: The study sets they create and their study progress
consentLimits1: Sets cannot be published publicly or found in search
consentLimits2: Their name is hidden on shared leaderboards
consentLimits3: No third-party advertising, and personal data is never sold
consentLimits4: You can ask us to delete the account and its data at any time
consentApproved: Thank you. {name}'s account is approved and ready to use.
consentDeclined: The account and everything collected for it has been deleted.
consentAlready: This request has already been answered.
consentExpired: This link has expired. A new one can be requested from the app.
consentNotFound: We couldn't find this request. The link may be incomplete.
